test.method: One whole-program score-block permutation; slots preserved; actual mixed dispatch.

ood.method: One whole-program score-block permutation; slots preserved; actual mixed dispatch.

replay_test.method: One whole-program score-block permutation; slots preserved; actual mixed dispatch.

protocol.primary: Steered full-vocabulary outer accuracy versus same weights disabled and validation-selected fixed action.
protocol.confidence: Paired complete-program bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed2026; no multiplicity correction.
protocol.shuffled_control: One preregistered groupwise score permutation with exact action counts and actual mixed dispatch.
protocol.runtime: All parameters on GPU; no offload scheduler, KV cache, or independent learned controller copy.
protocol.replay: Previously inspected old-task retention diagnostic; not a new generalization test.

parameters.routing_scope: one MLP substitution; original attention order; no KV cache
parameters.controller_role: predict continuation utility from live activation and geometry
parameters.controller_context: all detached nonpadding outer activations plus two shared anchor/query tokens
parameters.controller_readout: FP32 dot of selected activation with the difference of two shared head rows, divided by 4
parameters.controller_readout_precision: same FP32 elementwise product/reduction in both modes; transient casts only
parameters.absolute_v4_relation: same mathematical A/B margin formula; not bitwise BF16 head-output rounding
